name: About Us
title: About USA Anime Club | Independent Anime & Manga News
desc: Meet USA Anime Club, an independent publication covering anime, manga, manhwa and online fiction for readers in the United States.
kw: USA Anime Club about, independent anime news USA, manga manhwa journalism, editorial approach
content:
USA Anime Club is an independent publication for US readers following Japanese anime and manga, Korean manhwa, and online-serialized fiction. We cover announcements that affect what readers can watch, read or buy, with links to the organizations making those announcements.

What we cover

Our reporting includes new anime adaptations, confirmed streaming plans, English manga and manhwa editions, webtoon industry developments and serialized fiction releases. We explain the US relevance of an announcement and distinguish a Japanese broadcast, a regional streaming license, a digital chapter and a collected print volume.

Start with the latest reports or browse Anime, Manga, Manhwa and Web Novels.

How we report

Articles identify their source and its date, summarize the confirmed development, and explain important unanswered questions. Official publisher, distributor, broadcaster and platform records are our starting points. A release date outside the United States is not presented as confirmed US availability unless the source says so.

Our Editorial Policy describes sourcing, attribution and independent editorial responsibility. If a factual statement needs attention, the Corrections Policy explains how to request a review.

Publication and contact

USA Anime Club Editorial is the publication byline on our reports; it is not a claim about a named reporter's credentials or firsthand attendance. USA Anime Club is not affiliated with the anime studios, publishers, streaming platforms or fictional properties it covers.

For story leads, feedback or rights inquiries, email satyaprasadwork@gmail.com. We welcome relevant information, but sending a suggestion does not guarantee coverage.

name: Contact Us
title: Contact USA Anime Club | News Tips, Corrections & Rights
desc: Contact USA Anime Club for anime and manga news tips, corrections, source questions, accessibility feedback or copyright concerns.
kw: contact USA Anime Club, anime news tips, manhwa press submissions, manga corrections contact
content:
For editorial questions, news leads, factual corrections, accessibility feedback or rights concerns, contact satyaprasadwork@gmail.com. Email is our public contact channel; there is no account or submission form on this website.

Email USA Anime Club

Send a news tip

We welcome relevant announcements about anime, manga, manhwa and web novels, especially developments with a confirmed US audience or distribution impact. A useful submission includes:

  • The official announcement or publisher page, not just a repost.
  • The announcement date, the people or organizations involved, and the applicable country or territory.
  • Release formats, platforms or schedules only where a source confirms them.

Submissions are considered editorially. They are not automatically published, endorsed or described as independently reported until checked.

Request a correction

Include the exact article URL, the sentence you believe is inaccurate, the correct information and a dated supporting source. Our Corrections Policy explains how changes are reviewed and noted.

Rights, privacy and accessibility

For a copyright or trademark concern, identify the page and material, explain your relationship to the rights holder, and provide a way to follow up. For accessibility problems, tell us the page and what failed; device or browser details are useful but optional. For personal-data questions, see the Privacy Policy.

Please do not send passwords, payment details, identity documents or personal information about others. We do not advertise a phone line, response deadline or physical newsroom address.

name: Editorial Policy
title: Editorial Policy | Sources, Accuracy & Independence | USA Anime Club
desc: How USA Anime Club selects stories, checks official sources, handles attribution, distinguishes US availability and corrects errors.
kw: USA Anime Club editorial standards, anime source verification, manga attribution policy, newsroom independence
content:
USA Anime Club reports on anime, manga, manhwa and online fiction with an emphasis on accurate dates, clear sourcing and usefulness to US readers. Our editorial standard is to separate what a source confirms from interpretation or information that has not been announced.

Story selection and sources

We prioritize announcements that change a reader's practical understanding: a licensed English edition, a confirmed adaptation, an official release window, a streaming arrangement or a documented industry development. We prefer dated statements from rights holders, publishers, distributors, broadcasters, platforms and public agencies. When a secondary report is used, its original announcement should be identified whenever available.

Press releases are sources, not independent product reviews. We attribute announced facts to the issuing organization and avoid presenting supplied promotional claims as separately established results.

Dates, geography and uncertainty

Japanese television broadcast dates, US streaming availability, print publication and digital serialization can follow different schedules. We identify the region, format and source date when they affect a claim. If a cast, platform, dubbing plan or exact premiere day is not confirmed, the article should say so rather than fill the gap with speculation.

Originality, images and editorial responsibility

Reports should add original explanation or comparison instead of simply reproducing an announcement. Source links support factual claims; external text, manga pages, screen captures and promotional images are not republished without permission or another applicable lawful basis. The article covers use original typographic graphics rather than official character key art.

Research and drafting tools may assist preparation, but a tool output is not evidence. Sources and claims still require editorial checking. We do not attribute firsthand attendance, interviews, reviews or testing to anyone who did not perform that work. Articles use the publication byline USA Anime Club Editorial unless a specific verified contributor is credited.

Corrections and commercial independence

Substantive factual mistakes should be corrected on the page, with a clear note where the change affects the article's meaning. Subsequent announcements are dated developments, not proof that an earlier accurate announcement was fabricated. See our Corrections Policy.

If sponsorship, affiliate links or paid placement are introduced, the relationship should be clearly disclosed. Payment does not guarantee favorable editorial coverage. Send source questions or feedback to satyaprasadwork@gmail.com.

name: Corrections Policy
title: Corrections Policy | Report an Article Error | USA Anime Club
desc: Report factual mistakes, broken source links or changed release information, and learn how USA Anime Club reviews corrections.
kw: USA Anime Club corrections policy, report anime news error, manga date correction, editorial accuracy
content:
We want readers to be able to question a date, title, attribution, source link or availability claim. If something appears wrong, email satyaprasadwork@gmail.com with the article URL and the specific issue.

What helps us review a report

  • The exact page and a quotation or description of the disputed claim.
  • The information you believe is correct, with an official or otherwise reliable source.
  • The date of the source, especially for changing streaming or publishing schedules.

Questions about broken links, mistaken names, geographic availability, credits or inaccessible content are welcome even when you do not have a complete replacement source.

How changes are handled

We compare the report with the supporting material and, when possible, the publisher, distributor or other original record. If a factual mistake is confirmed, we update the text. Significant corrections should include an explanatory note on the article and an appropriate modified date. Small typographical or formatting fixes may not need a separate notice.

A later release delay, licensing change or revised schedule is different from an error in a previously accurate report. Such developments should be dated and explained so readers can understand what changed.

Follow-up

We may ask for clarification or a better source before making a change. Submitting a request does not guarantee that every suggested edit will be accepted or that a reply will arrive within a fixed period. Our Editorial Policy explains the broader sourcing and attribution standards.

name: Privacy Policy
title: Privacy Policy | Cookies & Analytics | USA Anime Club
desc: Read how USA Anime Club handles analytics consent, browser storage, Google Fonts, Microsoft Clarity and email enquiries.
kw: USA Anime Club privacy notice, analytics cookies consent, GA4 Microsoft Clarity, reader data choices
content:
Last updated: November 15, 2026

This notice describes how the current USA Anime Club website handles information. You can read articles without creating an account or providing payment details.

Analytics are optional

The site's consent panel offers Accept analytics and Decline analytics. Google Analytics 4 (measurement ID G-G0TNMR0FQL) and Microsoft Clarity (project ID yyqq9cryjc) are loaded by our site code only after acceptance. They can measure page visits, device and browser characteristics, navigation and interactions. Clarity may create session recordings subject to its masking and privacy controls; analytics providers may use cookies or similar technologies.

Declining optional analytics prevents the website from loading its Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity measurement scripts. The website includes a Google AdSense publisher script for site verification and potential advertising. This script may contact Google independently of your analytics choice. Advertising eligibility and serving depend on the AdSense account and applicable consent requirements; having the script in place does not mean ads are approved or running. Where required, advertising consent must be managed through an appropriate certified consent management platform. The analytics buttons on this website do not provide or withdraw advertising consent.

Your choice and browser storage

Your decision is stored locally in your browser so the consent panel does not appear on every visit. Select Privacy choices in the footer to change it. If you previously accepted analytics and then decline, the page reloads to stop further analytics loading; this does not erase information already collected by a provider or control the separate Google AdSense script. Clearing your browser's storage may also reset your choice.

The live clock uses the time zone configured on your device. It does not request GPS coordinates or precise location permission.

Other services and links

The site requests font files from Google Fonts, which may receive ordinary connection details such as your IP address. Hosting and network providers may process technical access logs to deliver and protect the website. Articles may link to publishers and external services whose own privacy notices apply when you visit them. See Google's Privacy Policy and Microsoft's Privacy Statement.

Email enquiries and privacy requests

If you email us, your address and message are used to review and respond to the enquiry, and may remain in our email records. Please avoid sending sensitive personal information. For a question about your information or a rights request under applicable law, contact satyaprasadwork@gmail.com. We do not sell readers' personal information.

Children

USA Anime Club is a general-interest publication, not a service directed at children under 13. Please do not send personal information about children through editorial email.

name: Disclaimer
title: Disclaimer | Sources, Releases & Rights | USA Anime Club
desc: Important context about USA Anime Club's independence, third-party releases, editorial artwork, source links and changing availability.
kw: USA Anime Club disclaimer, independent anime publication, release information accuracy, copyright trademarks
content:
USA Anime Club is an independent editorial publication. It is not operated, sponsored or endorsed by the studios, manga publishers, manhwa creators, streaming platforms, event organizers or other rights holders mentioned in its reports.

Release information may change

Announcements reflect the information available from cited sources at the time reported. Streaming catalogs, territorial licenses, dates, prices, language options and product inventory can change. A Japanese television premiere does not automatically establish a US release. Before purchasing tickets or books, arranging travel or subscribing to a service, confirm the current details with the provider.

Names, artwork and ownership

Anime and manga titles, logos, characters and trademarks belong to their respective owners. Original typographic illustrations on this website are editorial graphics, not official character art or evidence of affiliation. Links to external sources are provided for attribution and further verification, not as an endorsement of those websites.

Editorial information and corrections

Articles are provided for news and general information; they are not personal legal, financial or professional advice. We work to identify source dates and qualifications but cannot guarantee that every outside statement will remain current or that third-party sites will remain available. If you identify an inaccurate statement or have a rights concern, use our Corrections Policy or email satyaprasadwork@gmail.com.

Reading, sharing and reasonable use

You may read articles, share their URLs and quote limited portions where permitted by applicable law. Please credit the publication when referring to its reporting. Do not impersonate USA Anime Club, interfere with site availability, attempt unauthorized access or use automated requests in a way that disrupts the service.

Content and intellectual property

Original writing, layout and illustrations created for USA Anime Club may be protected by copyright. Republishing complete articles or repackaging the site's original graphics requires permission unless an applicable legal exception permits it. References to anime, manga, manhwa, web novel titles and rights holders do not transfer ownership of their names, characters, images or trademarks. Nothing here limits rights that the law grants to readers or copyright holders.

External websites and information

Links to official sources, publishers, distributors and other sites lead to independently operated services with their own terms and privacy rules. Release schedules, stock, prices, licensing and links can change. Editorial coverage should not be treated as a promise that a product or stream will be available in every location.

Availability and updates

We may correct or update site content, functionality and these terms as the publication evolves. We do not guarantee uninterrupted access or error-free third-party information. Applicable consumer and other mandatory legal rights remain unaffected.

For questions, rights enquiries or concerns about these terms, contact satyaprasadwork@gmail.com. See also our Privacy Policy, Editorial Policy and Disclaimer.
